sources.name: City of Leadville calendar (leadville-co.gov)
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. https://www.leadville-co.gov/ answered 403 to automated readers (not retried). https://www.colorado.gov/leadville redirected (302) to https://cityofleadville.colorado.gov/, which answered 404. Web search results point to leadville-co.gov as the City's site, with a /city-council page saying council meets the 1st and 3rd Tuesdays at 6 pm at 800 Harrison Ave, meeting pages with agendas and an iCal option, and an /about-leadville/page/recreation page linking the Lake County Recreation Department and the Mineral Belt Trail; none of those pages could be read, so nothing from them is in the guide. Council meetings should come from here once an editor can read it.

sources.name: Visit Leadville Twin Lakes (Lake County Tourism Panel) community calendar
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. The tourism site for Leadville and Twin Lakes, with the visitor center at 460 Harrison Ave (719-486-3900, summer hours daily 10-5). /events/ is a community-submitted calendar (an Add Event form at /events/community/add/): on 10 October it showed 12 October 2026 items, among them live music and trivia at the Pastime Saloon (120 W 2nd St), Trivia Tuesdays at The Famous (313 Harrison), Thursday family bingo at the Elks Lodge (123 W 5th), trivia and a paint-and-sip at FREIGHT (320 E 9th), Cloud City Mead's anniversary (609 D Hwy 24), a Community Fall Fest and Haunted Hills run at Colorado Mountain College (901 S Hwy 24), and a Victorian Spirits talk at the Healy House (Oct 16, 5:30 pm, $8-10, staged). Treated as an aggregator for everyone else's events; its own items (OctoberVille: fireworks and parade rescheduled to October 17, no time) are the only ones it can source. Home page also links /listing-category/annual-events/, /know-before-you-go/ (fire closures) and business directories. Page title still said February-March 2025 while listing October 2026. No feed found.

sources.name: Lake County Public Library
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. Home page gives 1115 Harrison Ave, 719-486-0569 and hours (Mon, Wed 10-6; Tue, Thu, Fri 10-5; Sat 12-4; Sun closed), published as a place. /library-events-calendar rendered only its heading (events load in the browser), and /events-programs is a hub for Kids (0-11), Teens (12-17), Adults and the annual Banned Books Week Celebration, without dates. Only dates seen: a 2026 copyright and 'Library Service Disruptions August 3 & 4' with no year. Look for a feed or a calendar URL that renders server-side.

sources.name: Forest Service, Leadville Ranger District (Pike and San Isabel National Forests)
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. All pages answered 200. /alerts lists the Willow Fire Area Closure (Order 02-12-01-26-39, Oct 1-Dec 31 2026 unless rescinded, NFS land south of Turquoise Lake to the north side of Halfmoon Creek), Interlaken Hotel and Annex closure (June 22, 2026), Turquoise Lake Road (CR 4) closure dated April 7, 2026 with access via CR 9C, and older wilderness and food-storage orders. Read and used: /recreation/turquoise-lake-recreation-area (2026 boat-ramp hours May 1-Sept 7, 6 am-8 pm; last updated May 1, 2026), /recreation/mount-elbert-fourteener (trails #1484 4.3 mi and #1481 5.8 mi, directions; updated April 15, 2026), /recreation/mount-massive-fourteener (updated March 12, 2026), /offices/leadville-ranger-district (810 Front St, 719-486-0749, 8-4:30, closed federal holidays; updated March 26, 2025), /alerts/willow-fire-area-closure-0. /recreation/leadville-ranger-district lists Halfmoon East and West campgrounds as temporarily closed and links every Turquoise Lake and Twin Lakes site. Not a calendar; a conditions source for the access blocks.
